title: Water Damage Mitigation Training Note: Standing Water and Drying Days
content:
**Training note — Water Damage Mitigation drying estimate**

Water that stood before the crew arrived lengthens drying: when the job's opened date is two or more days after its loss date the drying days in the drying estimate are the tier's billable drying day cap plus one day, when the job was opened on its loss date they are the cap less one day, and in any other case no standing-water change applies.

## Questions answered
**Which dates count?** The loss date and the opened date on the job record, counted in calendar days.

**Crew booked on the day of the loss?** The drying days are the tier's cap less one day.

**Booked the day after?** Exactly one day: no standing-water change.

**Booked two or more days later?** The drying days are the tier's cap plus one day.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier cap of 6 days, loss on the 4th)
| Opened on | Days after the loss | Drying days |
|---|---|---|
| the 4th | 0 | 5 |
| the 5th | 1 | no standing-water change |
| the 6th | 2 | 7 |
| the 11th | 7 | 7 |
